simple.intro: Two quick permissions, then your voice does the typing. We’re preparing speech recognition in the background.

speechSetup.description: A one-time speech download, saved on this Mac. You can keep going while it finishes.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tucky
welcome.subtitle: Grant the permissions below, pick a speech model, then start dictating anywhere. Screen Recording is optional — only needed if you want meetings to capture the other person's audio.

microphone.title: Microphone
microphone.subtitle: Tucky needs your microphone to capture what you say.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.subtitle: Required to paste transcribed text at the cursor in any app.

screenRecording.title: Screen Recording
screenRecording.subtitle: Lets Tucky capture the other participant's audio during Zoom, Google Meet, and other meetings. Without it, only your microphone is recorded.

permissions.promptHint: Approve the macOS dialog that just appeared. If it didn’t show up, click “Grant access” again to open System Settings.

llmModel.title: Local AI model
llmModel.description: Powers the Tucky command — saving thoughts and tasks by voice, and classifying them. Dictation works without it — skip to come back later.
llmModel.skippedNote: Skipped. Saved thoughts stay unclassified until you pick a model in Settings.

dictationShortcut.title: Dictation shortcut
dictationShortcut.description: Press and hold to record. Default is Right Control — change it here if that conflicts with another app.

skipButton.label: Skip setup for now
skipButton.note: You can browse Tucky now and finish setup later in Settings.

resetTcc.confirmBody: This wipes Microphone + Accessibility + Screen Recording grants, quits Tucky, and reopens it automatically so you can re-grant access. Continue?
resetTcc.timeoutError: Reset returned but the app didn't quit. Try restarting manually.

mcpConnect.title: Connect your AI (optional)
mcpConnect.subtitle: Let Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP-capable client — including ChatGPT Desktop — read and search your recordings and notes.

claudeCode.title: Claude Code
claudeCode.hint: Install runs: claude mcp add (user scope).

other.title: Other MCP clients
other.hint: Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, ChatGPT Desktop — standard mcpServers JSON.

mcpConnect.skipHint: You can do this anytime from Settings → Coding Agents.

installationCount.title: Help count Tucky installations (optional)
installationCount.body: If you choose to be counted, Tucky sends one first-launch event with only its version and platform. No recordings, transcripts, usage history, or device identifier are included. The counting service sees your connection’s IP address but is configured not to retain it. A flag stays on this Mac to prevent another report.
installationCount.sent: Your installation was counted. No further reports will be sent.
installationCount.declined: Your choice is saved. Nothing was sent.
installationCount.saved: Your choice is saved. No further reports will be sent.
installationCount.unavailable: Counting is not enabled in this build. Nothing is sent.
installationCount.optional: Nothing is sent unless you choose “Count this installation”. You can continue setup without choosing.
installationCount.loadError: Could not read the local counting preference. Nothing was sent. You can continue setup.
